correctness.rationale: Every claim is derived from a complete constrained-order selection proof, exact two-block symmetry, and the normalized hypergeometric local CLT with the correct finite variance and boundary rounding. The exact finite collision formula was independently matched to counts of Gaussian order regions for all 70 nontrivial splits in dimensions 4 through 8, including brute-force objective optimization for dimensions 4 through 6. No finite result is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural single facet split of an angularly equidistributed hypersimplex produces a genuine sampling-mode separation: the split-facet vertices hold positive Gaussian angular mass but a vanishing uniform fraction in the critical window, and dominate all repeated Gaussian optima with a sharp \(\sqrt n\) collision enhancement. Both the exact distribution and limiting constant quantify a motivated intrinsic geometric statistic rather than a routine f-vector restatement.
